summary: Smoke run committed batch ids main:0/recent:0 for rows 0-1024; full run computes batch ids as part:start so its first batch is ALSO main:0 (rows 0-262144) -> it skips the first 262K-row batch of both partitions, silently losing ~522K rows. Caught during monitoring before much damage.
root_cause: Smoke (REEMBED_LIMIT=1024) and full run share the same batch-id namespace (part:start). Smoke committed the low-id batch, so the full run treats the entire first commit-sized range as done. Bootstrap did not reset the checkpoint between smoke and full.
